name: Archangel
description: An archangel is a powerful creature that acts with the will of the entities that rule the Plane of Divinity. These beings rarely interact with the material plane except in the most dire situations, and instead are reserved for the most consequential missions such as leading campaigns in the lower planes. It is said that not even the most skilled liar can deceive an archangel.

actions.name: Divine Slash
actions.description: The archangel slices their blade through the air, creating a thin layer of celestial energy in a 7 unit cone, dealing divine energy.

actions.name: Celestial Blade
actions.description: The archangel makes an attack with with their celestial sword, dealing physical damage.

actions.name: Heavenly Call
actions.description: The archangel lifts their sword to the heavens, infusing it with divine energy. Until the start of their next turn, the archangel deals an additional 5d6 divine damage with their Celestial Blade action.

actions.name: Lance of Purification
actions.description: The archangel hurls a spear of pure divine light at a target, dealing divine damage. Additionally, a creature who takes damage after mitigation cannot channel spells from the necromancy, witchcraft or demonic schools of magic until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Lay Hands
actions.description: The archangel lays their hands on a humanoid, beast or divine creature, restoring them to half of their health and curing any diseased, poisoned, exhausted and wounded conditions. This action can only be used once per day.

actions.name: Blinding Radiance
actions.description: In response to taking damage, the archangel releases blinding light centered on them, blinding all creatures within a 5 unit radius until the start of the archangel's next turn.

actions.name: Channel Divinity
actions.description: The archangel contributes an additional action to a spell they are channeling. If the action requirement is already met, the spell becomes charged.

actions.name: Ascension
actions.description: The archangel ascends, gaining a 1d4 bonus to all attack and defense checks for 3 turns, starting with the current turn. Additionally, the archangel gives off 6 units of holy light, dealing divine damage to any creature that ends their turn within the radius. This free action can only be used once per day, unless the archangel is located on the plane of divinity, in which case it can be used 3 times.

actions.name: Retribution
actions.description: In response to being targeted with a melee attack, the archangel retaliates against the attacking target with their Celestial Blade action.

traits.name: Divine Components
traits.description: The archangel does not require components to channel divine spells while on the Plane of Divinity.

traits.name: Enmity of Darkness
traits.description: When the archangel deals divine damage to a dark or undead creature, they must make a resilience check against half the divine damage taken or be destroyed.

traits.name: Celestial
traits.description: The archangel is immutable and gains an additional 10 physical mitigation against damage from melee attacks and ammunition that do not have the blackened property.

spells.name: Destroy Darkness
spells.description: You touch a dark or undead creature and pour divine power in an effort to unmake them. If the creature is of a lower level than your spell damage bonus modifier, it is destroyed.

spells.name: Divine Healing
spells.description: You target a creature within 12 units and restore some of their health as well as curing any paralyzed, deafened, blinded, maddened, poisoned, bleeding or diseased conditions on them. If the creature is brought to full health by this spell, any missing body parts are also restored.

spells.name: Wrath of the Gods
spells.description: You call 3 rays of light from the heavens, each one counting as a seperate attack at the same target within 30 units. Each attack that hits grants an additional damage dice on the next ray.

spells.name: Judgement
spells.description: You target a creature within 14 units and surround them in a radiant aura, dealing divine damage. Additionally, roll a 1d4. The affected creature suffers a penalty on all attack rolls equal to that amount until the end of of their next turn.
spells.chargeeffect: If the creature is dark or undead, the 1d4 becomes a 4.

spells.name: Defense Against Darkness
spells.description: In response to making a dodge, block or resistance check against an undead or dark creature, add an additional 1d4 to that check and any subsequent checks against those types until the start of your next turn.
